bio: Enjoy the Much Ado About Afternoon Tea at Swan London. Indulge in a selection of treats inspired by the play and worthy of Shakespear himself.  Indulge in the twists and turns of this beloved story whilst sipping on a delicious cocktail or mocktail as you take in the stunning views of St Paul’s Cathedral and the River Thames from their second-floor restaurant.  Afternoon Tea at Swan London doesn’t have to mean sweet and light. The Duchess of Malfi Gentleman's Afternoon Tea is a feast of savoury tea-time treats including San Marzano sun-dried tomato & parmesan arancini, beer battered Scottish haddock & chips and mozzarella & green olive scones with blue cheese butter – perfect for guests with more of a savoury-tooth.  Swan London is located at the Globe Theatre on London’s Bankside, and just a stone’s throw away from Borough Market, London Bridge and the Tate Modern. Pair their tea with a tour of the theatre or a show for a truly theatrical day out!
